name: kyoten-skills
description: Reusable Agent Skills for pnpm dependency/security maintenance, creative image processing and game asset extraction, and EN/JA/zh-TW trilingual translation

scripts.test:python:imgalpha: uv run --quiet --python 3.12 --no-project --no-config --no-build --exclude-newer P7D --with pytest==9.2.0 --with pytest-cov==7.1.0 --with pillow==13.0.0 --with numpy==2.5.5 --with scipy==1.18.1 python -I -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider skills/creative/transparent-background/scripts --cov=imgalpha --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.test:python:game-extract: uv run --quiet --python 3.12 --no-project --no-config --no-build --exclude-newer P7D --with pytest==9.2.0 --with pytest-cov==7.1.0 --with pillow==13.0.0 python -I -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider skills/creative/game-image-extraction/scripts --cov=game_extract --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.test:python:psd-flats-cleanup: uv run --quiet --python 3.12 --no-project --no-config --no-build --exclude-newer P7D --with pytest==9.2.0 --with pytest-cov==7.1.0 --with "psd-tools[composite]==1.27.0" --with numpy==2.5.5 --with pillow==13.0.0 --with scipy==1.18.1 --with attrs==26.1.0 --with aggdraw==1.4.1 python -I -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider skills/creative/psd-flats-cleanup/scripts --cov=color_cleanup --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.test:python:live2d: uv run --quiet --python 3.12 --no-project --no-config --no-build --exclude-newer P7D --with pytest==9.2.0 --with pytest-cov==7.1.0 --with pillow==13.0.0 --with numpy==2.5.5 --with scipy==1.18.1 python -I -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider skills/creative/live2d-from-image/scripts --cov=live2d_pipeline --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
scripts.test:python: pnpm test:python:imgalpha && pnpm test:python:game-extract && pnpm test:python:psd-flats-cleanup && pnpm test:python:live2d
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:python
